title: Fynaptix · Weekly Brief
heading: Emerging Tech Weekly
subheading: Nine sectors · one view · Refreshes Mondays ~12:30pm
disclaimer: Not financial advice · do your own due diligence

sector_scoreboard.story: No stance changes registered this week — the sector’s own review is now 7 days old — but Amodei’s “Pace the Frontier” essay and Broadcom’s 3.5GW Anthropic TPU deal are still setting the tone.
sector_scoreboard.fundamentals_check: OpenAI is in talks for a $1.2T+ round (vs. Anthropic’s $2.0–2.3T IPO target); the $3–4T capex-vs-$50–150B/yr-revenue gap is still the central tension.

sector_scoreboard.story: Symbotic upgraded to Core on its first GAAP-profitable quarter ($9M net income, $676M revenue, ~$22.6B backlog); Deere’s autonomous 9RX tractors add a new Watch-tier option.
sector_scoreboard.fundamentals_check: Tesla’s Optimus output ramped ~10x from Q2 to ~500 units/week, but AI generalization past supervised tasks is still unresolved.

sector_scoreboard.story: Anduril’s Fury wins the Air Force’s ~$5B CCA production contract, lifting Kratos on the engine read-through — but AeroVironment and Rheinmetall were both trimmed despite record backlogs.
sector_scoreboard.fundamentals_check: Palantir’s bull/bear split widens (~$214 vs ~$159) near $183; Gauntlet II again favored private newcomers over listed pure-plays.

sector_scoreboard.story: BWX Technologies cut to Watch after a third straight week of 52-week lows — despite a fresh investment-grade rating and new Army/DOE awards.
sector_scoreboard.fundamentals_check: Westinghouse is reportedly targeting a $50B+ IPO, up from ~$30B; still zero operating commercial SMRs.

sector_scoreboard.story: Energy Fuels and Lithium Americas both sized up on real deals, while Freeport was trimmed to Watch as its record copper run leaves essentially zero implied upside to target.
sector_scoreboard.fundamentals_check: Xi’s Washington visit delivered “relief, not resolution” — tariff cuts on ~$30B of goods, but China’s rare-earth export-licensing regime stands untouched.

sector_scoreboard.story: Rocket Lab raised as Iridium shareholders clear the merger (99.6% approval) and Planet Labs adds on its first profitable quarter, while Redwire was cut to Watch pending an explanation for $1.15B of insider selling.
sector_scoreboard.fundamentals_check: Starship Flight 14 — SpaceX’s first true orbital attempt — is NET today after three prior slips; SPCX remains ~26% below its post-IPO high.

sector_scoreboard.story: Eos Energy raised on a firmed-up 10MW/100MWh Google/MN8 deal and an $87M DOE loan advance for its second production line.
sector_scoreboard.fundamentals_check: Fluence’s SEC probe and slashed FY26 guidance keep weighing on how the market reads the whole storage stack; GE Vernova’s backlog holds at $176B.

sector_scoreboard.story: NVIDIA and Recursion both raised — BioNeMo keeps adding partners and Recursion locked in its first dated, multi-year revenue line — while Illumina was cut to Watch as GuruFocus flags it ~105% over fair value.
sector_scoreboard.fundamentals_check: Tempus AI’s $1.5B all-stock Personalis deal expands its MRD footprint even as the Guardant litigation stays unresolved.

sector_scoreboard.story: Alphabet raised on a genuine logical-qubit stability milestone; IonQ raised on its FY26 guidance hike to $450–460M, cutting forward P/S to ~40x from ~73x.
sector_scoreboard.fundamentals_check: Quantinuum (−9%) and Pasqal (−12%) fell despite real partnership news — a bifurcated week, not a broad rally.

cross_cutting_themes.title: The stance board turned over 18 positions this week
cross_cutting_themes.description: Symbotic, Deere, Kratos, Energy Fuels, Lithium Americas, Rocket Lab, Planet Labs, Eos, NVIDIA, Recursion, Alphabet and IonQ were all raised or added on a converting contract, a regulatory step or a partner-validated milestone; AeroVironment, Rheinmetall, BWX Technologies, Freeport, Redwire and Illumina were cut — mostly on a missed proof point or a valuation that outran the news, not a scandal.

cross_cutting_themes.title: Great tape, priced-in stock
cross_cutting_themes.description: Freeport hit a fresh copper record but trades at essentially zero implied upside to target; Illumina rallied another 7.45% into a GuruFocus fair-value gap of ~105%. Both were cut to Watch this week for the same reason: the news was real, the price had already run past it.

cross_cutting_themes.title: Order books keep growing faster than the stocks that hold them
cross_cutting_themes.description: BWX Technologies, Rheinmetall and AeroVironment all posted genuine backlog or contract wins this week, and all three were either cut or kept falling — the market wants execution proof now, not just a bigger order book.

cross_cutting_themes.title: Diplomacy delivered relief, not resolution
cross_cutting_themes.description: Xi’s Washington visit produced tariff cuts on ~$30B of goods but left China’s rare-earth export-licensing regime untouched; the same pattern shows up in AI (safety rhetoric without a slowdown) and defense (Golden Dome’s funding still needs a reconciliation bill).

cross_cutting_themes.title: The 10-year broke a 19-year ceiling
cross_cutting_themes.description: Treasury yields touched 5.1% on Sept 23 — the highest since 2007 — as markets price in another possible Fed hike on top of AI-linked debt issuance; long-duration names across quantum, nuclear SMRs and pre-revenue biotech feel it first.

news_of_the_week.title: Iridium stockholders approve Rocket Lab’s merger
news_of_the_week.description: 99.6% of votes cast; an FCC review is next, with closing now guided to mid-2027 — Rocket Lab raised to Core on the de-risking.

news_of_the_week.title: Anduril’s Fury wins a ~$5B Air Force CCA production contract
news_of_the_week.description: Split with General Atomics across 150 initial airframes; lifts Kratos’s engine read-through even as AeroVironment and Rheinmetall get cut on execution concerns.

news_of_the_week.title: Xi’s Washington visit ends in “relief, not resolution” on rare earths
news_of_the_week.description: Tariff cuts on ~$30B of goods, but China’s export-licensing regime stands unchanged; Freeport cut to Watch as copper’s record run leaves no implied upside.

news_of_the_week.title: Tempus AI agrees to buy Personalis for ~$1.5B
news_of_the_week.description: All-stock MRD deal expands the genomic-data platform; Illumina cut to Watch the same week GuruFocus flags it ~105% over fair value.

news_of_the_week.title: IonQ raises FY26 guidance 60% to $450–460M
news_of_the_week.description: The SkyWater foundry deal cuts forward P/S to ~40x from ~73x; shares +16% to $45.48, upgraded within Speculative alongside Alphabet’s logical-qubit milestone.

week_ahead.title: JOLTS & Case-Shiller
week_ahead.description: First labor-market read since the Sept 16 hike to 3.75–4%.

week_ahead.title: BWXT Investor Day
week_ahead.description: Management makes its growth case after a third straight week of 52-week lows.

week_ahead.title: ADP, GDP final & PCE
week_ahead.description: The Fed’s preferred inflation gauge alongside a growth revision.

week_ahead.title: ISM Manufacturing PMI
week_ahead.description: First broad read on how the economy is absorbing a 5.1%+ 10-year and a fresh hike.

week_ahead.title: September jobs report
week_ahead.description: The week’s single biggest data point for the Fed’s next move.

week_ahead.title: Anthropic IPO pricing
week_ahead.description: Pre-roadshow meetings underway; ~$2.0–2.3T target before the midterms.

week_ahead.title: Anduril’s ~$100B round
week_ahead.description: Still unclosed roughly ten weeks after first being reported.

stance_changes.name: Symbotic
stance_changes.why: First GAAP-profitable quarter ($9M net income on $676M revenue, +23% YoY) with a ~$22.6B backlog and raised Q3 guidance.

stance_changes.name: Deere & Company
stance_changes.why: Autonomous 9RX tractors and an autonomous commercial mower rolling out, but no standalone autonomy revenue disclosed yet — a slow-burn option, not a sized position.

stance_changes.name: Kratos Defense
stance_changes.why: Anduril’s Air Force CCA production award confirms the whole ecosystem — engines included — is moving from R&D into production dollars.

stance_changes.name: AeroVironment
stance_changes.why: Shares down ~40% over 12 months and 25% in a month with nine EPS downgrades in 30 days, despite a real $464.8M laser contract.

stance_changes.name: Rheinmetall
stance_changes.why: A record €80.5B backlog didn’t stop shares sliding on delivery delays, quality concerns and the €12.8B F126 loss.

stance_changes.name: BWX Technologies
stance_changes.why: Third straight week of new 52-week lows even after a first-ever investment-grade rating and new Army/DOE awards — moved to Watch pending the Sep 29–30 Investor Day.

stance_changes.name: Freeport-McMoRan
stance_changes.why: Copper’s record run pushed the stock to essentially zero implied upside versus the average analyst target, with the Section 232 tariff decision still unresolved.

stance_changes.name: Energy Fuels
stance_changes.why: The $299M Australian Strategic Materials acquisition is a genuine step up in vertical-integration ambition.

stance_changes.name: Lithium Americas
stance_changes.why: JPMorgan upgraded to Overweight ($6 target) on higher lithium-price assumptions as Thacker Pass construction advances.

stance_changes.name: Rocket Lab
stance_changes.why: Iridium stockholders approved the merger (99.6% of votes), clearing the last major deal-completion risk beyond a pending FCC review.

stance_changes.name: Planet Labs
stance_changes.why: First profitable quarter, a new Berlin facility, and a rally on the Google Project Suncatcher tailwind.

stance_changes.name: Redwire
stance_changes.why: A NITE STAR IDIQ slot doesn’t resolve $1.15B of net insider selling disclosed against a roughly $1B market cap.

stance_changes.name: Eos Energy
stance_changes.why: A firmed-up 10MW/100MWh Google/MN8 deal and an $87M DOE loan advance for the Thorn Hill second line — funded by trimming NRGV.

stance_changes.name: NVIDIA
stance_changes.why: BioNeMo keeps adding partners — Novo Nordisk’s AI drug-discovery work ties back to the platform this week.

stance_changes.name: Recursion
stance_changes.why: Extended its Tempus AI data deal to $42M through Nov 2029 — the platform’s first quantifiable, multi-year revenue line.

stance_changes.name: Illumina
stance_changes.why: GuruFocus flags shares ~105% over fair value after another 7.45% gain, with a mechanical Russell mid-cap removal underway.

stance_changes.name: Alphabet
stance_changes.why: Google Quantum AI’s logical-qubit stability milestone is genuine technical substance, ending a quiet run on Willow-specific hardware.

stance_changes.name: IonQ
stance_changes.why: Raised FY26 revenue guidance 60% to $450–460M on the SkyWater foundry deal, cutting forward P/S to ~40x from ~73x.
